component.name: WoeUSB-GUI
component.summary: Universal Windows USB bootable installation flasher for Linux

description.p: WoeUSB-GUI is a modern, responsive Linux desktop application for creating bootable Windows USB installation media from ISO images.
Designed to operate reliably within an unprivileged Flatpak sandbox across any Linux distribution:

ul.li: Safeguards internal drives by strictly discovering only removable USB storage devices
Performs user-space extraction without requiring loop mounts or root privileges
Automatically splits install.wim files larger than 4 GB into .swm chunks for full FAT32 UEFI Secure Boot compatibility
Coordinates disk formatting and mounting via standard host UDisks2 D-Bus daemon
